Payment reminders

Reminders are emailed to customers about sent invoices that are overdue and not fully paid. Never about paid, void, disputed or stopped invoices.

Emailing is off: it needs can-core's email service and a published public invoice link (docs/finance.md).

Up to five increasing numbers, for example 7, 14, 30. One reminder for each, at least three days apart.

Older debts get no automatic reminder.

Company in a Can finance. Apache-2.0. A tool, not accounting, tax or legal advice.
